### Claim 4 — InMemoryRepository::apply_transfer_grant atomicity + error mapping
**Verdict:** PASS
**Evidence:**
At `domain/src/in_memory.rs:1868-1955`. Method body:
- Acquires Mutex-guarded lock at `:1872`: `let mut state = self.lock()?;` — single-lock atomicity pattern matches plan §7 P2 Deliverable 2.
- Validates sender grant exists at `:1876-1880` → maps to `RepositoryError::NotFound`.
- Validates sender grant not already revoked at `:1883-1888` → maps to `RepositoryError::Conflict(...)` (no new variant added — matches implementer P2 deviation #3).
- Validates recipient grant id is fresh at `:1894-1899` → `Conflict`.
- Validates resource match at `:1904-1909` → `RepositoryError::InvalidArgument`.
- Validates recipient holder == new_owner at `:1914-1918` → `InvalidArgument`.
- Validates OWNED_BY edge exists for sender's holder at `:1928-1938` → `Conflict` (cardinality precondition).
- Commit phase at `:1941-1953`: rewrites edge owner (`:1942`), revokes sender grant via `revoked_at = Some(payload.at)` (`:1945-1947`), mints recipient grant (`:1949-1952`).

All three writes happen under the single `state` lock — atomicity invariant honoured. Pre-flight validation gates ensure no partial mutation on rejection.

### Claim 5 — SurrealStore::apply_transfer_grant BEGIN/COMMIT + DELETE/RELATE
**Verdict:** PASS
**Evidence:**
At `store/src/repo_impl.rs:2691-2819`. Pre-flight read-side validation at `:2693-2773` (sender exists → NotFound; not revoked → Conflict; resource match → InvalidArgument; recipient/new_owner match → InvalidArgument; system-axiom rejection → InvalidArgument; OWNED_BY-edge probe → Conflict). Critical compound-tx at `:2791-2816`:
```sql
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
DELETE type::thing('owned_by', $old_edge_id) RETURN NONE;
LET $f = type::thing('node', $resource_id);
LET $t = type::thing('node', $new_owner_id);
RELATE $f -> owned_by -> $t SET id = type::thing('owned_by', $new_edge_id) RETURN NONE;
UPDATE type::thing('grant', $sender_id) SET revoked_at = <datetime> $at RETURN NONE;
CREATE type::thing('grant', $recipient_id) CONTENT $recipient_body RETURN NONE;
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
```
DELETE+RELATE pair rewrites the immutable graph-edge `out` field per implementer P2 deviation #2. All three logical writes (edge rewrite, sender revoke, recipient mint) inside the same `BEGIN TRANSACTION ... COMMIT TRANSACTION` block. Comment at `:2784-2790` documents the rationale + all three steps.
